INSIDE THE MODEL

What goes into a pick

The factors, the testing, and a place to keep your ideas.

NBA + NFL

Core inputs

IN USE
  • Team strengthElo ratings update from final scores and opponent strength.
  • Home advantageAccounts for the home team; NFL neutral-site games are treated separately.
  • Sportsbook marketThe model blends three parts market consensus with one part team rating. The market is adjusted to remove the books’ built-in margin.
  • Available oddsAt least three books, the best available price, time until tipoff or kickoff, and a minimum model edge determine which games qualify.

NBA + NFL

Factors being evaluated

AUTOMATIC

Waiting for the latest model details.

The system tests supported factors on one historical season and checks the winner against a separate later season. A factor is used only if it clears both tests. Tests cover the team-rating component; historical sportsbook snapshots aren’t available. Passing doesn’t guarantee improvement in the full model or profit.

ON THE RADAR

Tracked, but not model inputs

NOT IN USE
Referee assignments

NBA crews are archived when available, but their effects have not been validated for the model. NFL referees are not collected.

Injuries, lineups & quarterbacks

Not directly incorporated. Sportsbook prices may already reflect some of this news.

Travel & time zones

Not currently measured. Rest days are evaluated separately.
